overview: The paper proposes Gradient-Aware Norm Alignment to resolve the asymmetric update dynamic and representational inertia in Pre-Norm MLLMs caused by norm discrepancy between high-norm visual tokens and low-norm text tokens, thereby restoring cross-modal attention and improving both multimodal and text-only performance.

modules.name: Multimodal Dataset Processing & Loading
modules.description: Handles the loading, image transformation, text tokenization, and batch collation for the two-stage training pipeline, accommodating the specific formats of the feature alignment and instruction tuning datasets.

modules.name: Base MLLM Architecture Construction
modules.description: Implements the standard LLaVA-style multimodal large language model architecture, integrating a frozen vision encoder, a visual projector, and a pre-trained large language model backbone with Pre-Norm residual connections.

modules.name: Gradient-Aware Norm Alignment Layer
modules.description: Implements the core innovation: a specialized LayerNorm layer inserted after the projector. It enforces norm alignment through target-norm-based initialization and resolves the resulting vanishing gradient problem via a Global Weight Compensation (GWC) mechanism implemented through a backward hook to decouple forward compression from backward gradient scaling.

modules.name: Model Integration & Forward Propagation
modules.description: Assembles the baseline model with the norm alignment layer, managing the flow of visual and text tokens through the network, and ensuring the proper injection and concatenation of visual features into the LLM's input sequence.

modules.name: Two-Stage Training Workflow
modules.description: Implements the training loop controlling the two-phase optimization process: feature alignment pre-training and full-model instruction tuning, including learning rate scheduling, gradient accumulation, and optimizer stepping.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Executes the inference loop across the suite of multimodal and text-only benchmarks, computing accuracy metrics for both visual understanding tasks and core language understanding tasks to validate holistic model improvement.

modules.name: Norm Discrepancy Analysis
modules.description: Provides diagnostic tools to extract and statistically analyze the L2 norms of visual and text tokens at the modality interface (before and after projection) and across network layers, validating the existence and persistence of norm imbalance.

modules.name: Asymmetric Dynamics Probing
modules.description: Calculates and tracks the inter-layer cosine similarity of hidden states for visual versus text tokens throughout the network depth, serving as a proxy to quantify representational inertia and asymmetric update rates.

modules.name: Attention Map Extraction & Visualization
modules.description: Extracts cross-modal attention weights from specific layers and generates spatial heatmaps over input images to visualize the shift from diffuse, positionally biased attention in baseline models to semantically focused attention in norm-aligned models.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment Controller
modules.description: Manages the experimental configurations for controlled ablation studies, including comparisons between baseline, naive norm alignment, norm alignment with Global Weight Compensation, and different initialization strategies for the alignment layer.
